messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired -> rdw-inference-eu-embeds (high)
incident-bot: Summary: sustained 5xx rate > 2% over 3m; region=eu-west, service=embedding-serve, escalation: auto-escalate -> pagerbot
incident-bot: Alert link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98765

jordan: ACK (taking initial ownership) :hand:
jordan: I'm looking at pod errors now, giving timeline + quick checks
jordan: @alex if I need to hand off in ~12m, can you be standby?

pagerbot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 5m to @sre_lead if not claimed

alex: roger. I'm on standby. first quick check: are we seeing rollouts in eu cluster? anyone touched autoscaler config last 30m?

jordan: logs show a new autoscaler version rolled 6m ago, kube events show rapid scale up/down loop starting ~00:05 UTC
jordan: excerpts:
```
2026-03-15T00:04:12Z embedding-pod-3 OOMKilled
2026-03-15T00:04:40Z hpa embedding-serve scaled from 12 -> 48
2026-03-15T00:05:02Z embedding-pod-7 CrashLoopBackOff
```

alex: that explains flapping. autoscaler overshot, pods crash, readiness probes fail -> 502/5xx. Good catch.

maria: quick customer impact: ~120k requests in last 10m, 95th latency jumped to 12s, ~2.3% 5xx rate for eu customers; some paying customers reported degraded embeddings in support tickets.

tina: tagging product: @product-ops FYI, we've got intermittent failures for embeddings in EU region, may affect recommendation pipelines

jordan: action plan:
- pause autoscaler / set max replicas to current stable (prevent further churn)
- roll back autoscaler commit that went live ~6m ago
- route traffic to fallback model variant in us-west for heavy customers (short term)
- create incident channel and notify SRE

alex: I'll do the HPA / autoscaler change. bumping to manual scaling for now.

alex: running:
```
kubectl --context=eu-west patch hpa embedding-serve -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 24}}'
kubectl --context=eu-west annotate deploy embedding-serve redwood/temporary-scaling=true --overwrite
```

pagerbot: Note: patch applied by alex at 00:11 UTC

jordan: spinning up extra replicas with pinned image (known stable):
```
kubectl --context=eu-west set image deployment/embedding-serve embedding=registry.redwood/embedding:v20260228-stable
kubectl --context=eu-west scale deployment/embedding-serve --replicas=24
```

maria: starting traffic reroute for high-traffic customers -> fallback us-west model. this will affect latency but reduce 5xx. will message customers in batch after mitigation.

sre_lead: good plan. i'll join bridge in 2m and start post-incident checklist. please capture timestamps and who did what.

alex: confirm readiness checks now passing on 70% of pods. errors dropped but still seeing occasional 502s from old crashloops.

jordan: monitoring metrics: 5xx rate down from 2.3% -> 0.6% in last 4m. p95 latency trending down to ~3.2s. good.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-98765 status -> acknowledged by jordan, escalated to sre_lead

sre_lead: taking ownership for the incident. assigning postmortem owner = alex. oncall rotation note: incident severity set to SEV2.

tina: I'm taking over live ops for the next handoff; alex please leave any remaining run commands in the incident doc.

alex: leaving runbook snippet in incident doc (inc-98765):
- reverted autoscaler commit id: a3c9f2
- manual scale to 24 replicas
- pinned stable image registry.redwood/embedding:v20260228-stable
- traffic reroute rule id: rr-20260315-eu->usw

maria: customer comms draft queued, will send to affected account managers once we confirm stability (target: 30m)

jordan: thumbs: :thumbsup: 5xx rate stable below 1% for 6m. moving to monitoring for the next 30m, keeping incident channel open.

sre_lead: agreed. we'll keep PD incident open until we fully roll back autoscaler change and validate 1h of stable metrics. assign follow-ups.

tina: handing official ownership back to oncall rotation notes: i'll own the monitoring window, ping me for any regressions. leaving short note:
- watch hpa events
- watch pod restarts
- rollback complete once no new CrashLoopBackOff in 30m

jordan: thanks team. closing immediate PD ack chain but keeping the Slack thread as incident log. :eyes:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-98765 status -> resolved (pending postmortem)"
